goal: FG-315: a dropped responsibility is owner_dropped; target_findings case responsibility_dropped, known-bad dropped_responsibility_ignored

components.summary: Keeps one target and checks component parent design, merged code and tests.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target without executing models or code checks; reject a retired design marker in a current model as an error while preserving the existing target marker rejection; keep component_parent_unknown, component_parent_cycle and component_parent_layer as target design errors

check the current tree with the target applied using native static checks and fresh model proofs with bound tests; separate design errors from code and test work; write no project files or caches; keep entrypoint_owner findings as design errors; keep independently missing implementation anchors as code to-do when target-declared component containment is valid, with genuine regression coverage for the current and invalid-parent boundaries; retain runner_model retirement errors as errors rather than code to-do
identify exact current component, model and flow findings covered by the target; preserve unplanned failures and expose the same static target checks without model execution

promote a target after one complete check and unchanged checked inputs, writing its prepared map and model bytes, leaving changed components draft, and reporting partial I/O failures without automatic recovery
stop a target that silently drops an entrypoint, state or side effect
show invariant_untested as a model warning while retaining proof and known-bad failures
report a responsibility that loses its owner
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check

components.summary: Owns map schema, component sub-systems, model bindings and direct component fingerprints.
responsibilities: validate, load and save the map, writing depends_on sorted and deduplicated; read, validate and merge the one target map as a pure overlay without changing the current tree; resolve one complete optional model view with canonical paths and explicit missing mappings, retaining ordinary registry behavior by default; validate explicit entrypoint, state and side-effect removal intents against the current map without deleting extra content; register only contract models and report each leftover legacy runner location once as a runner_model migration error, including in a target view; accept optional component parent (sub-systems) while keeping direct file ownership and component fingerprints unchanged
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions

read model literals (MODEL_ID, PARENT, COMPONENTS, IMPLEMENTED_BY, TESTED_BY, NOT_MODELED) without importing the model; recognize the optional project_parent_state hook; retain retired design-marker literals solely to diagnose misplaced current models
count strings as dependency evidence only in import-like contexts

build the model tree: PARENT, default parents and model imports; nesting mistakes are errors; derive each model's components from COMPONENTS, anchor owners and home; distinguish root home from a component named system; warn when a model's bound test file is outside every component's test patterns; a child import of its explicit model parent does not invert the tree, while impact keeps the real import edge; only in a target view, keep a missing child anchor inside a component parent when its declared files match that path, while ordinary current, model-parent and unmatched-path containment keep their errors; expand only explicit COMPONENTS protections across component descendants, without expanding placement-only PARENT scope
treat an unknown PARENT, a PARENT loop, parent_import_mismatch, child_outside_parent and duplicate_child_owner as errors; keep test_not_nested and child_start_gap as warnings
resolve imports through removed model paths supplied by impact without registering historical models as executable nodes
record model imports made inside functions apart from top-level imports
count calls through injected attributes as dependency evidence
accept flow steps that read an earlier step's file
accept responsibility retirement in target remove
